import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:crypto/crypto.dart';
import 'package:drift/native.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:seguimiento/data/database.dart';
import 'package:seguimiento/domain/dates.dart';
import 'package:sqlite3/sqlite3.dart' as sqlite;

import '../support/sqlite_host.dart';

String _quoted(String identifier) => '"${identifier.replaceAll('"', '""')}"';

/// Synthetic fixture generated by the actual AppDatabase of frozen e6b420a,
/// before schema22 existed there. No downgrade of a current database.
void main() {
  setUpAll(useHostSqlite);

  test('frozen actual schema21 →22 →reopen preserves every old column and row',
      () async {
    final fixture = File('test/fixtures/schema21_122/fixture.sqlite');
    final manifest = jsonDecode(
            File('test/fixtures/schema21_122/manifest.json').readAsStringSync())
        as Map<String, Object?>;
    expect(manifest['source'], 'e6b420a66c55f0da82ee4dc97ebf31c7155ac98a');
    expect(sha256.convert(fixture.readAsBytesSync()).toString(),
        manifest['fixtureSha256']);
    final tables = manifest['tables'] as Map<String, Object?>;
    final expectedNames = tables.keys.toSet();
    expect(expectedNames, contains('catalog_patches'));
    expect(expectedNames, isNot(contains('goal_versions')));
    expect(expectedNames, isNot(contains('coach_proposals')));
    expect(
        (tables['morning_checks']!['columns'] as List<Object?>)
            .cast<Map<String, Object?>>()
            .map((c) => c['name']),
        isNot(contains('feeling')));
    for (final name in [
      'catalog_patches',
      'sessions',
      'session_sets',
      'foods',
      'meals',
      'meal_items',
      'ai_conversations',
      'ai_messages',
      'morning_checks'
    ]) {
      expect(tables[name]!['rows'], isNotEmpty, reason: name);
    }

    final dir = await Directory.systemTemp.createTemp('seguimiento-schema21-');
    final file = await fixture.copy('${dir.path}/fixture.sqlite');
    AppDatabase? db;
    try {
      // Independent SQLite read before AppDatabase22 can run its migration.
      final before =
          sqlite.sqlite3.open(file.path, mode: sqlite.OpenMode.readOnly);
      try {
        expect(before.select('PRAGMA user_version').single.values.single, 21);
        final names = before
            .select(
                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'")
            .map((r) => r['name'])
            .toSet();
        expect(names, expectedNames);
        for (final entry in tables.entries) {
          final columns = (entry.value['columns'] as List<Object?>)
              .cast<Map<String, Object?>>()
              .map((c) => c['name'] as String)
              .toList();
          expect(
              before
                  .select('PRAGMA table_info(${_quoted(entry.key)})')
                  .map((r) => Map<String, Object?>.from(r))
                  .toList(),
              entry.value['columns'],
              reason: '${entry.key} schema before');
          final fields = columns.map(_quoted).join(',');
          expect(
              before
                  .select(
                      'SELECT $fields FROM ${_quoted(entry.key)} ORDER BY $fields')
                  .map((r) => Map<String, Object?>.from(r))
                  .toList(),
              entry.value['rows'],
              reason: '${entry.key} rows before');
        }
        expect(before.select('PRAGMA foreign_key_check'), isEmpty);
      } finally {
        before.dispose();
      }

      final migratedOn = dayKey(DateTime.now());
      List<Map<String, dynamic>>? firstGoals;
      for (var opening = 0; opening < 2; opening++) {
        db = AppDatabase(NativeDatabase(file));
        expect(db.schemaVersion, 22);
        expect(
            (await db.customSelect('PRAGMA user_version').getSingle())
                .data
                .values
                .single,
            22);
        final names = (await db
                .customSelect(
                    "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'")
                .get())
            .map((r) => r.data['name'])
            .toSet();
        expect(names.difference(expectedNames),
            {'goal_versions', 'coach_proposals'});
        expect(names.containsAll(expectedNames), isTrue);
        for (final entry in tables.entries) {
          final columns = (entry.value['columns'] as List<Object?>)
              .cast<Map<String, Object?>>()
              .map((c) => c['name'] as String)
              .toList();
          final info = (await db
                  .customSelect('PRAGMA table_info(${_quoted(entry.key)})')
                  .get())
              .map((r) => r.data)
              .toList();
          expect(info.where((c) => columns.contains(c['name'])).toList(),
              entry.value['columns'],
              reason: '${entry.key} old columns after');
          expect(
              info
                  .where((c) => !columns.contains(c['name']))
                  .map((c) => c['name'])
                  .toList(),
              entry.key == 'morning_checks' ? ['feeling'] : <String>[],
              reason: '${entry.key} only schema22 column');
          final fields = columns.map(_quoted).join(',');
          expect(
              (await db
                      .customSelect(
                          'SELECT $fields FROM ${_quoted(entry.key)} ORDER BY $fields')
                      .get())
                  .map((r) => r.data)
                  .toList(),
              entry.value['rows'],
              reason: '${entry.key} rows after opening $opening');
        }
        expect(
            (await db.customSelect('SELECT feeling FROM morning_checks').get())
                .map((r) => r.data['feeling']),
            everyElement(isNull));
        expect(await db.customSelect('SELECT id FROM coach_proposals').get(),
            isEmpty);
        final goals = (await db
                .customSelect(
                    'SELECT id,metric,value,effective_from,accepted_at,origin,reason,policy '
                    'FROM goal_versions ORDER BY id')
                .get())
            .map((r) => r.data)
            .toList();
        expect(goals, hasLength(10));
        for (final entry
            in (manifest['expectedGoalValues'] as Map<String, Object?>)
                .entries) {
          final rows = goals.where((r) => r['metric'] == entry.key).toList();
          expect(rows, hasLength(2), reason: entry.key);
          expect(rows.map((r) => r['value']), everyElement(entry.value));
          expect(rows.map((r) => r['effective_from']), [null, migratedOn]);
          expect(rows.map((r) => r['accepted_at']), everyElement(migratedOn));
          expect(rows.map((r) => r['origin']), everyElement('legado'));
          expect(rows.map((r) => r['policy']), everyElement(1));
          expect(rows.map((r) => r['reason']), everyElement(isNull));
        }
        if (firstGoals == null) {
          firstGoals = goals;
        } else {
          expect(goals, firstGoals,
              reason: 'reopen neither duplicates nor rewrites goals');
        }
        expect(
            await db.customSelect('PRAGMA foreign_key_check').get(), isEmpty);
        expect(
            (await db.customSelect('PRAGMA integrity_check').getSingle())
                .data
                .values
                .single,
            'ok');
        await db.close();
        db = null;
      }
    } finally {
      await db?.close();
      await dir.delete(recursive: true);
    }
  });
}
